summary: Review-grade V1.1 reduction of the supplied KS007G23B STEP solid. Exact B-Rep dimensions and sampled freeform evidence are retained as provenance, while the V1.1 blade and hub model remains a lossy reconstruction.

source_metadata.authority: The supplied STEP is authoritative for the imported B-Rep topology and dimensions listed in step_brep_analysis.
source_metadata.mapping_loss: The V1.1 DSL does not preserve the source STEP faces, exact blade NURBS, stepped spline bore, three auxiliary holes, balancing details, or manufacturing tolerances. This preset is not STEP-equivalent CAD.
source_metadata.applicability_limit: Use for visual and semantic review of the V1.1 reduced constructor only. Use the supplied STEP itself for source geometry inspection.
